outcome: Procoagulant activity of MP (PPL clotting time)
cohort: Thirty-two pregnant women in labour, consisting of 16 with preeclampsia and 16 without preeclampsia.
finding: The study found that total, platelet activated-derived, leukocyte-derived, and tissue factor-bearing microparticles (MP), as well as MP procoagulant activity, were significantly higher in both maternal and cord blood of women with preeclampsia compared to normotensive women, while platelet-derived MP levels were lower in the PE group.
cross-section timing: At labour and immediately after delivery
